title: One year of Trump 2.0: how he's weaponised AI as political propaganda
summary: As Donald Trump marks one year back in the White House, Vedika Bahl takes a closer look at how he has weaponised artificial intelligence into a top political tool, used to glorify himself, attack his opponents and amplify his political agenda.
